purpose: Read-only engineering diagnosis of renewed visual projection saturation and final clean prediction-error redistribution; not a training or model-selection experiment.

runtime.diagnostic_algebra: numpy float64 on actual float32 projection inputs

interpretation_guards: Initial parameters must match original initial SHA; final frozen parameters must match original checkpoint SHA.
All 396 final clean predictions and all 48 original per-episode scores must replay exactly.
Unique-row projection statistics do not use overlapping-window weighting and must not be equated numerically with prior activation window statistics.
Diagonal-covariance reference is descriptive coordinate-correlation algebra, not an intervention or causal contribution percentage.
Step0/final200 endpoints cannot establish saturation onset; sampled-batch loss and gradient bins are not fixed-set learning curves.
Primary observed_action and separate normalized_zero_action are never pooled.
Use original float64-before-subtraction MAE/RMSE and float32 SmoothL1 beta=1; total objective equals visual mean plus 0.25 state mean.
Error bins are fixed baseline-conditioned shared bins within each seed/arm; contributions use whole-episode denominator and then equal-episode mean.
Empty bins retain zero support with null conditional means; conditioning permits regression-to-mean and does not prove denoising.
No branch-gradient causal attribution, new normalization fit, architecture upgrade, loss tuning, policy benefit, or independent-test claim.
